## Problem

What are you trying to do that v8malloc doesn't currently let you do
(or does poorly)? Real workloads / numbers help a lot.

## Proposed solution

A description of the change you'd like to see. If it touches the
public API surface or the design docs under `.claude/docs/`, please say
which.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you weigh, and why is the proposal above the
better one?

## Impact

- API stability: does this break the existing `V8MALLOC_1.0` ABI?
- Performance: expected improvement, regression, or neutral?
- Platforms: applies to all Tier 1/2/3 architectures, or only some?

## Additional context

Links to prior art (jemalloc / mimalloc / tcmalloc PRs, papers, …),
benchmark scripts, or anything else useful.
